cancelled: The raffle was cancelled. No winner will be drawn.
claim.late: @{raffle:user} the claim window for that prize has closed.
claim.none: There is no raffle prize waiting for @{raffle:user} to claim. Winners: type !claim!
draw.empty: No one entered the raffle. Nobody to draw.
err.loyalty_off: Raffle prizes are paid in loyalty points. Turn Loyalty on, or set the raffle prize to 0 for a raffle without points.
err.usage: Usage: !raffle [amount] [seconds], !mraffle [amount] [seconds], !raffle draw|cancel|status. Amounts take k and m (5k). Viewers enter with !join
join.already: @{raffle:user} you are already in this raffle ({raffle:count} entered).
join.closed: @{raffle:user} no raffle is running right now.
joined: @{raffle:user} you're in! {raffle:count} entered so far. Good luck!
last.confirmed: Last raffle: {raffle:targets} won from {raffle:entrants} entries ({raffle:confirmed}/{raffle:total} confirmed).
last.empty: The last raffle closed with no entries.
last.none: No raffle has been drawn here yet.
open.already: A raffle is already running! Type !join to enter it.
opened: Raffle is LIVE! Type !join to enter. Drawing in {raffle:mins} min!
opened.secs: Raffle is LIVE! Type !join to enter. Drawing in {raffle:secs} sec!
payout.failed: Some raffle {raffle:points} could not be paid. A mod can add them with !points add.
payout.loyalty_off: Loyalty is off, so this raffle paid no {raffle:points}.
remind: Raffle reminder: ~{raffle:mins} min left! {raffle:count} entered so far. Type !join!
remind.claim: Raffle reminder: ~{raffle:mins} min left! {raffle:count} entered so far. Type !join! Winners must !claim.
status.closed: No raffle is running. Mods can start one with !raffle or !mraffle.
status.open: Raffle is live with {raffle:count} entered. Drawing in ~{raffle:mins} min! Type !join!
status.open.secs: Raffle is live with {raffle:count} entered. Drawing in ~{raffle:secs} sec! Type !join!
won: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! You won the raffle ({raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants})! Type !claim within {raffle:claim} min to get {raffle:prize}!
won.plain: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! You won the raffle ({raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants})!
won.points: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! You won the raffle ({raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants}): {raffle:amount} {raffle:points} per winner, already in your balance!
won.points.claim: {raffle:targets}, congratulations! You won the raffle ({raffle:count} winner(s) from {raffle:entrants}): {raffle:amount} {raffle:points} per winner, already in your balance! Type !claim within {raffle:claim} min to get {raffle:prize}!
